title: S1.5 ux-intake boundary manifest (generate-ux-pack output)
description: Boundary manifest for the S1.5 UX-intake node (ux-intake): fronts the S1.5 UX pack produced by generate-ux-pack. Permissive (additionalProperties:true) so the pack can also carry the per-artifact path map, p1/p2 findings and coverage gaps. Exposes the pack directory plus the design-token / route-map paths the TL handoff consumes, and the pack maturity that gates S4b frontend-implement.

pack_dir.description: Root directory of the UX pack.

tokens_path.description: Path to the design-token file (tokens.json) the TL handoff consumes.

route_map_path.description: Path to the route map the frontend leg consumes.

component_inventory_path.description: Optional path to the component inventory.

maturity_level.description: UX pack maturity (mirrors generate-ux-pack: 0=skeleton, 1=basic, 2=draft, 3=ready-for-implementation); gates S4b frontend-implement (raise the gate as the pack matures).

status.description: Pack status discriminator emitted by generate-ux-pack.

viewer_file.description: Path to the self-contained offline HTML viewer for the pack.

human_view.description: Additive render-policy hint for the human-review layer; absence == default (generic tree).
